references.text: Parallel list of unclean birds in Leviticus that mentions the kite and various species of falcons, with the same prohibition against eating birds of prey.
The complete list of unclean birds in Leviticus corresponding to the list in Deuteronomy 14, including birds of prey and scavengers.
Isaiah mentions the kite as a bird that gathers in the wilderness, showing that these birds were known in an Israelite context.
